surface_mechanism_description: In ALD, a cycle of gas-phase reactants is used to deposit a fixed amount of material per cycle. In the steady state, alternating exposures to Al(CH3)3 and H2O deposit 0.11 nm of amorphous Al2O3, and each alternating exposure to WF6 and Si2H6 deposits 0.5 nm of W.
evidence: In the steady state, alternating exposures to Al(CH3)3 and H2O deposit 0.11 nm of amorphous Al2O3 (12), and each alternating exposure to WF6 and Si2H6 deposits 0.5 nm of W (13).
